description: This file contains implementation of the TransactionProtoParser class, including methods to serialize and deserialize TransactionState, DisplayState, LayerCreationArgs, and related data structures to and from protobuf messages. It also defines a FakeExternalTexture class used for handling external textures within the surfaceflinger namespace.

classes.name: FakeExternalTexture
classes.description: A mock implementation of renderengine::ExternalTexture used for testing or placeholder purposes, encapsulating texture properties such as size, format, and usage.
